section.label: Pets
section.description: Small figures that show what your agents do.

enabled.label: Pets
enabled.description: A small figure on every agent shows what it does, and jumps when it needs you. Click a pet to go to its node.

place.label: Where pets are
place.description: On their nodes, or roaming the bottom of the screen.

subagents.label: Sub-agents
subagents.description: A smaller figure walks along with a pet for each sub-agent at work, up to three.

visitor.label: Visitor
visitor.description: While Pets is off, a pet now and then drops by beside a node for a few seconds.

sprite.label: Figures
sprite.description: Pick one or more packs. Each agent keeps one figure. Buddies and Animals give every provider its own; the other packs spread their figures over your agents.

custom.label: Your own figures
custom.description: A PNG or WebP strip of square frames side by side. Up to {{frames}} frames of {{size}} pixels, {{kilobytes}} KB at most.

dialog.description: Every state can have a strip of its own. One without plays Standing, which every figure needs.
dialog.name: Name

problem.type: Pick a PNG or WebP image.
problem.bytes: This image is larger than {{kilobytes}} KB.
problem.unreadable: This file could not be read as a PNG or WebP image.
problem.frame-small: A frame is at least {{min}} pixels high.
problem.frame-large: A frame is at most {{max}} pixels high.
problem.frames-whole: The width must be a whole number of square frames.
problem.frames-many: A strip has at most {{frames}} frames.
problem.full: You can keep {{limit}} figures at most. Remove one first.
problem.room: Your figures take {{total}} KB together at most. Remove one or pick a smaller strip.
problem.storage: There is no room left to keep this figure.

inViews.label: In views of their own
inViews.description: A chat or terminal open as its own view has a pet too, on the composer or in the terminal's bar.

agents.title: Per agent
agents.label: A figure per agent
agents.description: Give a CLI a pack or one fixed figure, such as Nox for Codex. That overrides the packs you turned on. A CLI on Default uses those packs.

beam.label: Teleport
beam.description: How a pet appears and leaves when its agent starts or ends, and when you turn pets on or off.
